sv.title: Tufft jobb att leverera mat till äldreboenden i Umeå under snökaoset
sv.summary: Att få ut rullvagnarna med mat till äldreboendena under snöstormen i norr var tufft. Men det måste göras. – Vi har ett jobb att sköta 365 dagar om året, vi åker i alla väder, säger chauffören Mathias Gerström.

en.title: Tough job delivering meals to care homes in Umeå during the snow chaos
en.summary: Getting the trolleys of food out to the care homes during the snowstorm in the north was tough. But it has to be done. "We have a job to do 365 days a year, we drive in all weathers," says driver Mathias Gerström.
